caption: The drawing depicts six marionette puppets suspended on strings against a plain, off-white background. The central puppet is the largest and is dressed in a loose, flowing garment that combines pastel orange, blue, green, and floral patterns, with its face featuring prominent eyes, arched eyebrows, and pink lips. Blue ribbon or fabric is tied around its neck. Surrounding the central figure are five smaller marionettes, each with exaggerated, rosy-pink faces, large eyes, and dressed mostly in black, baggy outfits except for the upper left puppet, which wears a multicolored, patterned garment. Each puppet has strings attached to their heads, suggesting manipulation from above. The limbs of all puppets dangle towards the bottom of the page. The lines connecting each puppet to the top of the drawing are thin and black, simulating the appearance of control strings. The composition is arranged symmetrically, with three marionettes on each side of the central figure.
title: Lano's Pop Out Marionette
